story.fullStory:
Jesse Mccartney's "Shake" reached #54 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Shake" is the original lead single from American singer and actor Jesse McCartney's supposedly fourth studio album, Have It All.

The song peaked at #54 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Shake was released in 2010.
